## IInferSchemaValue type

Value type inferred from a schema class's value columns.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IInferSchemaValue<D extends Record<string, IAnyColumnBuilder>> = {
    [K in keyof (IRequiredColumnsOf<D> & IOptionalColumnsOf<D>)]: (IRequiredColumnsOf<D> & IOptionalColumnsOf<D>)[K];
};
```
**References:** [IAnyColumnBuilder](./lmdb.ianycolumnbuilder.md)

## Remarks

Maps every value column to its TypeScript type — `T` by default, `T | undefined` for optional (`.optional()`<!-- -->) columns. Prefer the short alias [ValueOf](./lmdb.valueof.md) (`ValueOf<typeof UserSchema>`<!-- -->) over spelling this out — `IInferSchemaValue<typeof UserSchema.value>` resolves to the same value type, so values stay in sync with the schema definition without manual interfaces.
